en: A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing an early‑20th‑century European town square. Several automobiles and horse-drawn vehicles line the street, with people walking and gathering along the sidewalks. The architecture features multi‑story buildings with ornate façades and tiled roofs, and a church with domes is visible in the background. In the upper left corner is printed text identifying the location.
